Period-scoped: the cover's Totals-from-Last-Report is 31,610.05, this officeholder's account carried from the 2020/2022 cycles, and that money is not itemized here. FILER INCONSISTENCY retained, not adjusted: 31,610.05 + 24,300.00 = 55,910.05 but the filer's printed CUMULATIVE cell is 55,610.05, i.e. the filer's own cover is 300.00 out of balance on line 1. The itemized side is reconciled to the matching-scope figure (This Report), never to a differenced cumulative. 3-line 2024 form, so a single contrib_all cell and no <=$50 aggregate line - the line-1/line-2 basis rule does not apply.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): 17,474 00' = 17,474.00, which is also the cover's line-2 Totals-for-THIS-REPORT cell
expenditures.detail: 13 Form B rows sum to 17,766.00 against the filer's printed schedule total of 17,474.00 - a FILER-ARITHMETIC delta of +292.00, retained verbatim and never nudged. Traced as far as the document allows: this sheet prints NO per-page subtotal (only the grand total), so there is no sub-anchor to localize the error against; instead every one of the 13 amount cells was re-read on a tight --value crop at 900 dpi and the five least certain again at 1,200-2,400 dpi (1,050 / 2,500 / 1,320 / 2,000 / 126 / 1,320 / 2,500 / 200 / 250 / 1,200 / 2,800 / 1,000 / 1,500), and no single row, and no pair of rows, differs from the transcription by 292.00 - so the difference is the filer's addition, not a mis-read cell and not a missing row (the sheet's 13 filled rows were counted against the printed grid: 13 dates, 13 payees, 13 amounts, rows 14+ blank). The cover is internally consistent AT 17,474.00 (21,218.46 last + 17,474.00 this = 38,692.46 cumulative, exactly as printed), which is why the printed total, not the row sum, is named as the anchor. Both in-kind conventions were tested and neither closes: no row on this schedule is labelled in-kind, so monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind are the same 17,766.00. Period-scoped behind a cumulative cover (last report 21,218.46 carried from the prior cycle's account), i.e. this would be period-exact but for the 292.00.

itemized.notes: James H. 'Jim' Harvey, Weber County Commission Seat C, 2024 cycle, October 8 pre-election report (only that box ticked), signed 04 Oct. 2024. Handwritten 3-line county form; the filer writes SLASHED ZEROS throughout and ends most figures with a terminal dash flourish - under the zero-glyph ruling those are the digit 0. Page order is cover (40) / Form A (41) / Form B (42). The 'Address' column on Form A carries CITY ONLY in this filer's hand (one row adds a state, 'Santa Cruz, CA'); no street address is printed anywhere on the schedule, so nothing was withheld for privacy and a blank donor_state means the FILER printed none - it is not a county redaction (the county redacted nothing on these three pages; the candidate's own address is printed in full on the cover). Form B has no address column at all, only a City column, which is recorded in each expenditure row's note. OFFICEHOLDER-carried account: both cover lines open from large Totals-from-Last-Report figures (31,610.05 and 21,218.46), so both schedules are period-scoped and the cumulative column must never be read as 2024 fundraising. TWO independent filer defects are retained verbatim and NOT adjusted: (1) the cover's line-1 column arithmetic is 300.00 out (31,610.05 + 24,300.00 = 55,910.05 vs the printed 55,610.05); (2) Form B's own grand total is 292.00 below the sum of its own 13 rows. The 2026-08-01 totals tranche also flagged that this cover's line-3/line-4 Last-Report figures disagree with the filer's own prior report - a third, separate inconsistency in the same document.
